title: The Broken Playlist
author: Hazel Coldharbour
blurb: Elodie Brightwater, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must save the tradition that made the town before prom.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
